metadata.scope: Ten-operator, operator-owned public evidence only. Research snapshot for owner review, not production data.
limitations: No accounts, screenshots, purchases, funded tests, outreach, or access-control bypasses.
Search is discovery only. Search snippets, affiliates, and legacy site records do not substantiate values.
Unverified values are null, never zero. Partial values state their limits.
An access block is not evidence that an operator lacks a feature or has withdrawn from the US.
Public-page observation describes displayed content, not a completed transaction or independently tested service.
State lists describe operator notices, not legal advice or permission to route a player.
Promotions need another check before publication; no expiry is assumed from a page remaining accessible.
Raw local captures can contain IP addresses and are not committed. Source hashes identify rendered text unless explicitly marked PDF bytes.
Version 2 replaces sourceIds with evidence objects containing sourceId and locator; kyc is renamed verificationPolicy.
omittedComparisonAttributes: Exact total game inventory: inconsistent counting and no comparable census.
Full recurring daily-reward schedule: no complete, comparable schedule across the ten.
Standardized package-value basket: no shared verified price point across operators.
All-in redemption fees: no comparable, complete method-level schedule.
Authenticated balances, personalized offers, cashier menus and account-specific limits.
deferredOperationalTodos: Actual end-to-end redemption time and reliability.
Actual verification completion time and friction.
Account closure and safer-play control effectiveness.
metadata.todoPolicy: Deferred only, not comparison fields or scheduled work. Do not create accounts or conduct hands-on tests without a new owner decision.

attributes.entity: Named operator or contracting entity; roles distinguished where available.
attributes.productMode: Publicly supported play/prize model; separate promotional contests from ordinary gameplay.
attributes.currencies: Publicly identified currencies; labels alone do not establish redemption rights.
attributes.welcomeOffer: Signup and first-purchase offers separated; conflicting variants are not normalized into one offer.
attributes.purchaseRequirement: Free participation versus a specific paid offer; unknown offer conditions stay explicit.
attributes.dailyReward: Public recurring reward, base amount and claim interval where stated.
attributes.packages: Dated public price/currency examples, not a complete cashier or value ranking.
attributes.gamesProviders: Named categories or provider examples, not tested inventory.
attributes.playthrough: Published multiplier and exactly which coins it applies to.
attributes.redemptionMinimumCap: Published thresholds and caps with method, location and period.
attributes.redemptionMethodsTiming: Public methods and scoped processing guidance, not measured payout speed.
attributes.verificationPolicy: Public document requirements only, not observed verification experience.
attributes.restrictions: Dated operator exclusions or product-mode restrictions; not a legal conclusion.
